newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Belle, Sinophil up on gaming franchise talk.
newsitem.headline: Belle, Sinophil up on gaming franchise talk.

text.p: Belle Corp and its subsidiary Sinophil Corp posted gains in late trade on Tuesday on talks that Belle may be granted franchise for its jai-alai operations, traders said.
"They are relating it to jai-alai and that they may be allowed to operate within the year," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities.
Sinophil rose 0.3 centavos, or 15.79 percent, to 2.20 centavos in late trade. Belle, on the other hand, gained 10 centvaos, or 1.3 percent, to 7.60 pesos.

"The stocks are rising due to prospects that their gaming interests may soon be realised. Sinophil rose because of Belle's participation in the company and also because it is one of the best positioned gaming stocks," said an analyst from ING Barings.

Jai-alai, a ball game with gambling operations attached to it, was an extremely popular game in the Philippines but was stopped some two years ago because the company which used to operate it lacked a franchise.
Newspaper reports earlier said the House of Representatives approved the bill granting a Belle subsidiary the right to build, operate and maintain jai-alai frontons all over the country.
The bill, however, was recalled after two congressmen questioned the approval.
Sinophil and Belle were among the top ten most actively traded issues late in the session.
